text: Local authorities announced a new initiative to reduce traffic congestion in the city centre. Starting next month, private vehicles will be charged a fee to enter the busiest districts, while public transport will be expanded. Critics argue that the policy may disadvantage low-income commuters, but officials insist the revenue will be invested in affordable alternatives.

Cloud computing allows organisations to store data and run applications on remote servers instead of maintaining their own infrastructure. This approach improves scalability and reduces upfront costs, although it raises concerns about data privacy and vendor lock-in. Developers must therefore design systems that are resilient and portable.

Plastic pollution is one of the most serious threats to marine life. Every year, millions of tonnes of waste end up in the oceans, harming fish, turtles and seabirds. Governments and individuals can help by reducing single-use plastics and supporting recycling programmes.
